context.requirement_text: ISS-0790 / ISS-0806: module permissions/role_grants are typed as plain atom() — no compile-time check that a role_grants value atom is in permissions.

acceptance_criteria: AC1: A compile-time mechanism catches a role_grants atom not present in permissions
AC2: Existing runtime validate/1 behaviour unchanged

design_summary.macro_signature: defmanifest(fields) where fields is a keyword list literal
design_summary.expansion: def manifest/0 returning the manifest map from fields — satisfies @callback manifest/0
design_summary.compile_time_check: At macro expansion: for each {role, perms} in role_grants, each perm atom must be in permissions. CompileError raised if violated.
design_summary.error_message: role_grants atom :<ATOM> is not declared in permissions for module Elixir.<CallerModule>
design_summary.callback_kept_reason: Existing modules implementing def manifest/0 directly still satisfy the @behaviour; defmanifest is opt-in syntactic sugar

affected_files.change: Add defmacro defmanifest/1 with @doc describing argument contract and CompileError condition. No existing declaration modified or removed.
Switch def manifest/0 to defmanifest(...) using the same literal field values, demonstrating valid usage and exercising compile-time check positively.

test_strategy.AC1_negative: Code.compile_string/1 compiling a defmanifest with role_grants atom not in permissions must raise CompileError with the prescribed message
test_strategy.AC1_positive: Fixture module compiles cleanly after switching to defmanifest (known-valid manifest)
test_strategy.AC2: All existing CatalogTest cases pass unchanged; validate/1 and six-rule helpers are not modified

result.summary: Design artefact produced at lib/letflow/design/iss-0806-defmanifest-compile-check.md. All six sections complete; every acceptance criterion maps to a concrete design element; no open questions; no implementation code present. Ready for CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR.
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR for gate check
